authority_source.delegation: minimum adversarial fixture set is versioned by follow-up design authority before QUALIFIED status

rule: DD-042 may not become QUALIFIED_NONFINAL unless every mandatory adversarial dimension below is executed as a distinct planned fixture, all expected HOLD semantics are observed, and the qualification receipt binds this authority digest and the exact successor fixture plan.

mandatory_fixtures.purpose: A claim author may not independently source the evidence used to establish the same self-referential safety claim.
An evaluator may not establish its own correctness by acting as, or controlling, the oracle used for qualification.
The claim author or evaluator may not be the promotion authority that advances its own qualification.
Caller-declared independence is insufficient without independently verifiable provenance.
The independent adversarial evidence population must meet the current authority-bound minimum.
Transitive or shared-control lineage that creates a material self-approval loop disqualifies positive qualification.
